{"metadata":{"description":"Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness: channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions.","id":"gh:1334953406","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-chaos","slug":"hanxuanliang/dsh-chaos","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness: channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agen"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ti-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness: channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"Durable peer collaboration for Agents inside DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"`dsh-chaos` adds a local collaboration workspace to the official DSH Web UI. Create stable Agents, b"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ring them into Channels, discuss work in Threads, turn Messages into Tasks, and follow progress thro"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ugh a truthful Activity view. The collaboration record is stored in a transactional local ledger and"},{"id":"p3s4","text":" survives browser refreshes, plugin restarts, and Agent session replacement."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> [!IMPORTANT]
> Version `0.1.2` targets the DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` package line."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> [!WARNING]

The Agent can run commands without approval prompts and can read, modify, or delete any f"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ile available to the operating-system account running DSH; this does not grant privileges beyond tha"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"t account. Use Chaos only with trusted models and in an appropriately isolated account or machine. T"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"his is currently a fixed policy, not a user-selectable setting."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Inspired by Raft"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"`dsh-chaos` began with genuine admiration for Raft. Raft showed how human–Agent collaboration can be"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" treated as a durable product system: conversations, tasks, delivery, ownership, and recovery are ex"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"plicit shared facts instead of details hidden in a model transcript."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Chaos learns from that way of thinking and carries the inspiration into DeepSeek Harness through an "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"independent implementation. Raft remains the original inspiration and a project this work deeply res"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"pects; `dsh-chaos` is not affiliated with or endorsed by Raft."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Surface | Preview |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Channels and Threads |  |
| Task board |  |
| Agent management |  |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## What it adds"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Capability | What it changes |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| **Stable Agents** | An Agent keeps one identity, local custom avatar, Charter, managed Workspace, "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"Channel memberships, and runtime configuration even when its DSH Session is replaced. |
| **Channels"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" and Threads** | Channels carry an Agent-visible purpose and owner-managed active/archive/delete lif"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ecycle; Threads inherit parent access while Follow controls ordinary Agent delivery. |
| **Task life"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"cycle** | Any Message can anchor a numbered Task with explicit claim, assignee, status, version fenc"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ing, and a Channel task board. |
| **Authoritative delivery** | Message, recipient Delivery, and wak"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"e watermarks commit atomically, so restart recovery does not depend on provider transcripts or brows"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"er state. |
| **Activity inbox** | Active conversations are projected from committed Messages, Threa"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"d follows, Tasks, and Done fences instead of guessed client counters. |
| **Official DSH surfaces** "},{"id":"p14s10","text":"| The plugin uses the Sidebar, Settings, overlay, runtime, provider/model catalog, Agent Presets, an"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"d Workspace APIs supplied by DSH. |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Prerequisites"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`

Published npm installs do not run a native build."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"To build and link the current checkout instead, install Rust and run:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The plugin install remains linked to the checkout. A client-only rebuild need"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s only a browser refresh."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"1. The browser sends an authorized loopback RPC as the fixed local Web User.
2. Rust commits the Mes"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"sage, recipient Deliveries, wake watermark, and change-ledger event in one Turso transaction.
3. The"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" delivery bridge wakes each current Agent runtime generation with a content-free notice.
4. The Agen"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"t checks its durable inbox and receives the exact Messages plus stable identity, Charter, target, an"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"d role-bearing member context.
5. Model-seen receipts and Agent writes are fenced by the current Ses"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"sion generation, so stale Sessions cannot acknowledge or act for the Agent.
6. SSE invalidates brows"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"er projections; the client re-reads authoritative Rust/Turso state instead of treating the event str"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"eam as the source of truth."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The default data locations are:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The first path is the collaboration ledger, including bounded custom Agent avatar images. The second"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" is the managed Workspace root for each stable Agent."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Data and security boundaries"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- DSH is treated as a local product. Browser RPC and SSE accept trusted loopback, same-origin reques"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ts; this plugin does not add remote multi-user authentication.
- All browser tabs share one fixed lo"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"cal Web User. The browser is not allowed to impersonate an Agent.
- Agent-authored tool calls derive"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" identity from the trusted DSH execution context, not from caller-provided IDs.
- Every newly create"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"d or reset Chaos Agent Session is durably pinned to DSH's `danger-full-access` permission preset (`s"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"andbox: danger-full-access`, `approval: never`) before its runtime binding is published. Resuming a "},{"id":"p33s7","text":"Session replays its pinned permission facts instead of silently rewriting them.
- The plugin stores "},{"id":"p33s8","text":"provider/model/Preset references, not provider credentials. Provider credentials stay in DSH.
- Turs"},{"id":"p33s9","text":"o is the durable source of truth. Provider transcripts and browser caches are not collaboration auth"},{"id":"p33s10","text":"ority.
- One local DSH host process owns the database and runtime bridge. Coordinating multiple proc"},{"id":"p33s11","text":"esses against the same file is outside the current contract.
- Published installs select a platform-"},{"id":"p33s12","text":"specific native package automatically. Linux arm64, Linux musl, and Windows arm64 are not supported "},{"id":"p33s13","text":"in `0.1.2`.
